_doc: Phase 12 — cue table for typing an entity's restrictive prep-phrase modifier. A modifier's relation is decided by the resolved object, never by the preposition alone ('of' is ambiguous). 'site_concepts' are the curated concept ids that read as a locus/site, so a prep-phrase resolving to one is a 'localized_in' edge (e.g. dysbiosis OF the gut microbiome). Any other attributive 'of'/'within' phrase falls back to the generic, non-discriminating 'qualified_by'. A condition preposition like 'in remission' is left to the Phase-6 qualifier layer and is NOT a modifier.
